q: What's the tallest I can build my stand?
My stand structure is 3 metres high. Do I need to ask permission?
expected_facts: structures higher than 2.5 m require official authorisation

q: Will I be charged extra if my stand is taller than 4 metres?
expected_facts: applies to structures, flags, promotional material, logos, company names
exception: stand light fittings without promotional content or company logos

q: I'm building a two-storey stand. How far can the upper deck be from the aisle?
expected_facts: walking distance from any accessible location to the nearest hall aisle via the stairway must not exceed 20 m
stair units must be built to DIN 18065

q: Can I put a sliding door on the entrance to my stand?
expected_facts: swinging doors, curtains, revolving doors, code-entry doors and sliding doors are prohibited along escape routes

q: Can I store empty boxes in the aisle behind my stand during the show?
expected_facts: emergency exits, escape and rescue routes and hall aisles must be kept free at all times
doors along escape routes must be able to be easily opened

q: Do I have to submit my stand design for approval, and in what format?
expected_facts: all custom-built stands must receive approval

q: My stand has a solid ceiling. Do I need my own emergency lighting?
expected_facts: stands where existing general emergency lighting is ineffective due to their construction require their own additional emergency lighting

q: Can I use my own electrician to connect power to my stand?
expected_facts: the main connection is carried out by the official site electrician contracted by the Frankfurter Buchmesse
it is not permitted to supply electricity to neighbouring stands

q: How many exits does my 80 square metre stand need?
expected_facts: for stands of 100 m² or less, or intended for fewer than 100 visitors: at least one exit

q: My stand is 150 square metres and I expect around 250 people at a time. What exits do I need?
expected_facts: for more than 200 persons: at least 1.20 m width
exit widths graduated in 0.60 m increments per 100 persons

q: Do the same exit width rules apply to the staircase on my two-storey stand?
expected_facts: the same width requirements apply to stairways on two-storey structures

q: I want a small fountain on my stand. Is that allowed?
expected_facts: proper hygienic conditions must be maintained at all times
proof of compliance must be presented to Messe Frankfurt

q: We'll be producing waste during our demonstrations. Do we need to declare it?
expected_facts: incidences of manufacturing wastes shall be reported to Messe Frankfurt
stating the types and quantities of the materials involved

q: What's the height limit in Hall 12.1 for a 40 square metre stand?
How far can any point on my stand be from a hall aisle?
expected_facts: the distance between any point on an exhibition area and an exhibition hall aisle shall not exceed 20 m walking distance
